_what: Per-clip measurements of one identified panel region. Nothing is selected here; the ranked lists are evidence for a frozen plan.

region_config._what: The panel region, identified by eye from the audit's difference maps and frozen before any clip was selected.
region_config._identification: Full-resolution medians of 2_tr89 (class 2) and 6_tr16 (class 6) differ at the front of the eccentric press: a yellow-framed wire-mesh guard is in place in the class-6 clip and swung away in the class-2 clip. That guard is the object the two labels describe on this camera.

press_front.panel_box_note: x, y, w, h in the source 1920x1080 frame. Covers the yellow frame and the mesh inside it, with a small margin.
press_front.alignment_patch_note: Static scene well away from the press: the far wall, the coil stock and the orange machine. Used only to check that a clip is from this camera and pose.
press_front._reference_caveat: 2_tr89 has a worker standing in front of the guard, so its region is 'open and occluded'. It is usable as an open reference because the guard is absent in it, but it is NOT usable as a source for the same reason.

sampling._note: Medians are built from sampled frames, not every frame.

_caveats: A correlation against a reference is not a panel-state detector.
region_activity cannot tell a worker in front of the guard from the guard itself moving; both disqualify a source and the clip is inspected by eye before it is selected.
Clips whose alignment_ncc falls below the threshold are measured but excluded: the region box is in one camera's coordinates.
